Description
Buy this rare and unique vintage 10 Troy oz Engelhard poured gold bar to add to your collection.
These poured Engelhard gold bars are rarely seen, and are a must have for any serious investor. This bar has ripples, dips and various character marks acquired through the decades, giving it real presence.
These bars come with an assay certificate which is very rare.
The perfect bar for the bullion investor who already has one of everything else!
Initially founded in New Jersey by Charles W. Engelhard in 1903 as American Platinum Works, the Engelhard company quickly became one of the world’s most recognized producers and fabricators of platinum, gold, and silver bullion. Their products acquired a legacy status being collected and traded in volume by investors worldwide. Engelhard is among the most highly respected names in the precious metals industry, causing many investors to ask for only Engelhard bars
These bars are from the now closed Engelhard refinery and are seen by some collectors as having extra value due to their rarity.
10 oz Gold Bar Engelhard Vintage Poured Bar (Assay)
Consisting of 10 oz 9999 Fine Gold
Obverse: Features the Engelhard stamped logo along with the metal weight and purity
Reverse: Blank with natural striations and marks from the cooling process
Getting rarer everyday.
